policy: Recommended defaults are not prior user approvals. Batch consequential questions at their boundary, continue safe independent work, and leave unapproved effects off.

decisions.question: Initial workspaces, goal cards and background windows
decisions.recommended_default: Demand-only installation; explicitly opted-in focus records.
decisions.guard: Do not infer broad permanent permission from an architectural discussion.

decisions.question: Initial projects, toolchains, resource windows and scope of the already-requested scratch capability
decisions.trigger: Before enabling automatic execution or first experiment
decisions.recommended_default: Keep unqualified execution off; enable bounded CPU scratch for approved focused projects and explicitly covered GPU windows. No per-test approval within the grant; no network by default.
decisions.guard: Do not re-ask whether scratch coding/testing is wanted. Resolve deployment scope and authority; observe requests and role labels do not grant it.

decisions.question: Notifications and goal reminders
decisions.recommended_default: On-request/handoff context and small digest; no unsolicited repeated alerts.
decisions.guard: A goal hint should help a decision, not nag.

decisions.question: Retention and storage budgets
decisions.trigger: Before persistent user chat/experiment retention beyond existing policy
decisions.recommended_default: Bounded derived notes and source pins; no hidden reasoning archive.
decisions.guard: Do not choose private-history retention silently.

decisions.question: Fresh investigator access in coder MCP or old delegation reactivation
decisions.trigger: Only if a representative workflow needs a surface change
decisions.recommended_default: Preserve current12-tool coder and inactive delegation; existing reads plus local operator CLI.
decisions.guard: Internal agent capabilities do not automatically broaden public profiles.

decisions.question: Consequential runtime removals or unsupported legacy consumers
decisions.trigger: After source consumer inventory, before removal/cutover
decisions.recommended_default: Move owned core, retain forwarding compatibility and dormant semantics.
decisions.guard: Module names and routine import fixes are root decisions.

decisions.question: Interactive latency, automatic resource and residency envelope
decisions.recommended_default: At most one automatic model slot; demand may use both; explicit quiet and release modes.
decisions.guard: Do not promise instant preemption or savings from utilization alone.

decisions.question: Ordinary implementation and reversible tuning details
decisions.recommended_default: Use existing seams, focused tests and finite empirical candidates.
decisions.guard: Do not interrupt the user for filenames or every prompt word.

decisions.question: Optional KV persistence or broader framework adoption
decisions.trigger: Only after measured reconstruction cost or missing capability
decisions.guard: Upstream feature existence is not installed qualification or a reason to expand.
